notes.title: Version 0.0.8 Update
notes.notes: [olist][*][p][b]11 New Weapons Added[/b]: Micro Missile Launcher, Sticky Bomb Bow, Flamethrower, Frost Launcher, Venom Sprayer, Laser Gun, Ray Gun, Sonic Gun, Railgun, Aura Gun, and Crossbow.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Quality System[/b]: Dropped weapons now have random qualities. High-quality weapons will come with randomly generated affixes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Gameplay Option[/b]: Added an option in the settings menu to enable or disable automatically switching back to the starter pistol when out of ammo.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimizations & Bug Fixes[/b]: Implemented performance optimizations and fixed several known bugs.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.7 Update
notes.notes: [p](1) Significantly increased the reflect damage of Character "Huang"'s stance skill.[/p][p](2) Added a short period of invincibility after Character "Huang"'s stance ends.[/p][p](3) Weakened the charge effect of the Level 2 wild boar.[/p]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.6 Update
notes.notes: [olist][*][p]Fixed a bug that occurred when refreshing mutation skills after they reached the max level of 5.[/p][/*][*][p]All blade shockwaves can no longer pass through walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where crystals could not be picked up.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.5 Update
notes.notes: [olist][*][p]Fixed a bug where the boss's skill animations were not playing correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the boar boss's charge skill could incorrectly destroy indestructible boundary walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced the background music for the second boss battle.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.4 Update
notes.notes: [olist][*][p]Added a new UI notification for ultimate ability readiness.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized bullet/projectile performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Character 1 could revive while rolling.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.2 Update Notes
notes.notes: [olist][*][p][b]New Mechanic:[/b] The "Splitting Bugs" in Level 1 can now be executed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Adjustments:[/b] Slightly reduced the rocket projectile speed for Boss 1 during Phase 2.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character Balance:[/b] Increased the melee basic attack damage for the character "Ah Huang".[/p][/*][*][p][b]QoL Improvement:[/b] Expanded the vertical camera follow range to provide a wider field of view.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Fixed several known bugs and made general performance optimizations.[/p][/*][/olist]
